items: The idle cleanup preview says that disabled slots' running resources are included; manual, active, held, working and current-run slots stay excluded
Run counts in the sidebar badge, family views, dispatch warnings and pinned views use the same active rule as the Runs Active tab, and active views load every active run instead of the newest 1000
Run results, the acceptance tally and report links render from the same view model as Companion; a malformed web link in a report no longer opens
